test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers 1, 2, 4, 5, 7 and 9 are written on different faces of a dice, Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Which is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 9? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5e960c17872156ecca860ff4aaecd49642fc0a00f68c2a1c97bdb43f1807301.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 1, 2, 4, and 7 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 9 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a9d0f2f0b6f5bd449636799c30674601046c0eeb63a631378794d688e7d7cf5.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 7

2 → 4

5 → 9

So, the opposite side of "9" will be side "5".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
